BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to ethics investigations; and amending RCW42.52.450.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 42.52.450 and 1994 c 154 s 215 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) If a complaint alleges a violation of RCW 42.52.180 by alegislator or statewide elected official other than the attorneygeneral, the attorney general shall, if requested by the appropriateethics board, conduct the investigation under RCW 42.52.420 andrecommend action ((to the appropriate ethics board)). (2) If a complaint alleges a violation of RCW 42.52.180 by theattorney general, the state auditor shall conduct the investigationunder RCW 42.52.420 and recommend action to the appropriate ethicsboard.
